# Telamorph

> Telamorph is a composite engineering and manufacturing company in Sofia, Bulgaria. We develop and manufacture advanced composite components and build the MPK range of composite curing ovens and control systems.

Telamorph Ltd. covers composite projects from geometry preparation and design for manufacturing through FEA, laminate definition, tooling, production, curing, finishing, and assembly.

## Services

- [Composite Development](https://telamorph.com/composite-development.html): DFM review, part-split and mould strategy, material and laminate definition, reverse engineering, and FEA simulation.
- [Composite Manufacturing](https://telamorph.com/manufacturing.html): Tooling, vacuum infusion, prepreg, compression moulding, curing, bonding, assembly, and finishing from first article to series production.
- [MPK Industrial Solutions](https://telamorph.com/industrial.html): Composite curing ovens, touchscreen control systems, thermal units, and custom production systems designed and built in-house.

## Products

- [MPK Compact](https://telamorph.com/products/mpk-compact.html): For small-to-medium parts, this compact curing oven offers precise temperature control and programmable profiles.
- [MPK Workshop](https://telamorph.com/products/mpk-workshop.html): More working volume than the Compact, with a practical footprint for everyday composite workshop use.
- [MPK Production](https://telamorph.com/products/mpk-production.html): A production-focused curing oven for small-series manufacturing and larger technical components needing stable, repeatable cures.
- [MPK Large Format](https://telamorph.com/products/mpk-large-format.html): Built for oversized and demanding production workflows.
- [MPK Custom](https://telamorph.com/products/mpk-custom.html): A curing oven engineered around your exact part size, process, loading method and production workflow.
- [MPK CS](https://telamorph.com/products/mpk-cs.html): Industrial touchscreen control for composite curing — build, run and monitor multi-stage temperature profiles in real time.
- [MPK CS + TU](https://telamorph.com/products/mpk-cs-tu.html): Turn your own insulated chamber into a fully controlled composite curing oven with integrated heating, airflow and PID control.

## Capabilities

- Composite design and development
- 3D scanning and reverse engineering
- Design for manufacturing, part-split, and mould strategy
- FEA simulation and laminate definition
- Master models, milled tooling, direct moulds, jigs, and fixtures
- Vacuum infusion, prepreg, and compression moulding
- Composite curing, bonding, assembly, trimming, milling, coating, and painting
- First-article inspection and low-to-mid-volume series production

Materials include carbon fibre, fibreglass, aramid, flax, cores, resin systems, and coatings. Applications include automotive, motorsport, aerospace, UAVs, industrial equipment, and special composite projects.

## Case studies

Anonymised customer projects, each engineered, tooled and built by Telamorph from the customer's requirements to a tested composite part.

- [Composite bodywork for an automotive project](https://telamorph.com/case-studies.html#automotive-composite-body): Structural design, tooling, prototype and industrialisation of a 26 kg hybrid carbon-fibre and carbon-Kevlar body, integrated into several vehicles and production-ready for a third series.
- [Composite structure for an ultralight aircraft](https://telamorph.com/case-studies.html#ultralight-aircraft-structure): Structural architecture, laminates, thermal design, tooling and certification prototype; certified, in series production and built for dozens of aircraft with thousands of flight hours in service.
- [RF-transparent radome insert for a UAV](https://telamorph.com/case-studies.html#uav-radome-insert): RF-transparent sandwich radome with an epoxy system, made by infusion and out-of-autoclave prepreg, set into a carbon-fibre UAV skin; in low-volume production.
- [Watertight composite enclosure for a ship inspection drone](https://telamorph.com/case-studies.html#ship-inspection-drone-enclosure): Vacuum-infused glass-fibre/epoxy pressure enclosure with bonded ring frames and an equipment cradle, verified by staged leak and hydrostatic pressure testing.
- [Composite battery enclosure for an electric bicycle](https://telamorph.com/case-studies.html#e-bike-battery-enclosure): Sealed enclosure integrating a removable battery into an e-bike frame, with design and tooling ready for small-series production.
